seasonal_flow.protocol: Retrospective April 1 issue date. October–March precipitation, March temperature/SWE and March Terra snow only. Fixed ridge alpha=1; same complete years for every model; no held-out tuning.
seasonal_flow.limits: Provisional catchment; short record; reanalysis and retrospective snow product availability do not establish real-time forecast skill. No independent melt-source attribution.

reservoir.limits: Landsat-derived JRC water detections within HydroLAKES 14452 plus 1 km buffer; may include adjoining channels. Not independently validated shoreline area, bathymetry or storage. Cloud/no-data months remain gaps.

snow_policy.interpretation: Snow cover is classified area among valid pixels; NDSI values are not fractional snow cover.
